title: Advent Follow-Along
notice: Sample content for review. Final activities are coming soon.

messages.beforeBody: Each week brings a few simple things to do together at home. Take a look at Week 1 now, and come back on the first Sunday of Advent.
messages.afterBody: Thank you for following along this Advent. All the weeks are still here if you'd like to look back.

weeks.label: Week 1
weeks.title: Hope
weeks.intro: Advent begins with waiting and hoping. This week, notice the small signs of light in the dark evenings.

activities.title: Light the first candle
activities.description: Light one candle at dinner (or switch on a flameless one). Take turns naming something you're hoping for.

activities.title: Start a hope jar
activities.description: Write or draw a hope on a slip of paper and put it in a jar. Add one each day this week.
activities.details: Any jar or box works. Younger children can draw a picture instead of writing. Keep the jar somewhere everyone will see it, and read the slips together on Christmas Eve.

activities.title: Read the promise
activities.description: Read the short passage together and talk about what it means to wait for something good.

weeks.label: Week 2
weeks.title: Peace
weeks.intro: This week we make room for peace: in our homes, with our neighbors, and in quiet moments.

activities.title: Light two candles
activities.description: Light two candles and share one place where you'd like to see more peace.

activities.title: Take a quiet minute
activities.description: Sit together for one quiet minute before bed. Afterwards, share what you noticed.

activities.title: Make peace with someone
activities.description: Write a kind note to a friend, neighbor or family member, especially someone you've disagreed with.

activities.title: Prepare the way
activities.description: Tidy one small space together to get ready for guests or for Christmas.

weeks.label: Week 3
weeks.title: Joy
weeks.intro: The pink candle reminds us that joy is near. This week, look for ways to share it.

activities.title: Light three candles
activities.description: Light three candles, including the pink one. Each person shares one thing that made them smile today.

activities.title: Sing a carol
activities.description: Sing a favorite carol together. Bonus: sing it for a neighbor or call a grandparent and sing to them.

activities.title: Give a surprise
activities.description: Do a secret kindness for someone in your family or neighborhood.

weeks.label: Week 4
weeks.title: Love
weeks.intro: In the last days before Christmas, we remember that love came down to be with us.

activities.title: Light four candles
activities.description: Light all four candles and name someone who shows you God's love.

activities.title: Love in action
activities.description: Choose one way to help others this week, such as donating food, a warm coat or a toy.
activities.details: Ask at church about this year's collection drives, or pick a local food bank or shelter together as a family.

activities.title: Read Mary's story
activities.description: Read about the angel's visit to Mary and talk about how she said yes.

weeks.label: Christmas
weeks.title: Christ is born
weeks.intro: The waiting is over. Celebrate the birth of Jesus together.

activities.title: Read the Christmas story
activities.description: On Christmas Eve, read the story of Jesus' birth together, then open the hope jar from Week 1.

activities.title: Light the Christ candle
activities.description: Light all five candles. Say a short thank-you prayer for the gift of Jesus.

activities.title: A birthday for Jesus
activities.description: Share a special treat and sing "Happy Birthday" to Jesus.
